request.text: Four of us are meeting by West Lake in Hangzhou on September 1, 2026, in the afternoon. Check the weather and help me write our group a practical note about what to bring.

responsibilities.outcome: Retrieve the Hangzhou forecast for the specified afternoon and use it to draft a practical message to the user's friend group about what to bring.

new_goals.description: Prepare a practical group message based on the Hangzhou weather forecast for the planned West Lake meetup.
new_goals.source_text: Four of us are meeting by West Lake in Hangzhou on September 1, 2026, in the afternoon. Check the weather and help me write our group a practical note about what to bring.
constraints: Use the forecast for Hangzhou on September 1, 2026, in the afternoon.
Keep suggested items relevant to retrieved weather conditions.
success_criteria: Current forecast information is retrieved through the weather capability.
The resulting group note connects practical suggestions to that forecast without claiming it was sent.

semantic_facts: The plan should use the weather lookup capability for the specified Hangzhou date and period, then ground a practical friend-group message in the retrieved conditions.
forbidden_claims: The assistant invents forecast conditions without obtaining weather information.
The assistant claims it delivered the note to the group.
The planner substitutes a reminder or embodied action for the weather lookup.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A composite informational goal is split into unrelated goals instead of preserving one forecast-grounded communication outcome.
The planner drafts weather-dependent advice from assumptions and omits the sole authoritative lookup capability.
